name: MuonGC: row-centred Newton-Schulz Muon
tagline: Muon (Nesterov + Newton-Schulz orthogonalisation) on 2D matrices, with row-wise gradient centralisation applied before orthogonalisation; AdamW for embeddings.
diff_from_baseline: Adds Yong et al.-style gradient centralisation (subtract per-row mean) right before the Newton-Schulz orthogonalisation in the Muon baseline; same parameter routing and Newton-Schulz coefficients as the muon edit, but with a regularised gradient.

name: AdamW with per-tensor grad clipping
tagline: Single-tensor AdamW with explicit per-parameter gradient clipping inside step; uses β₂=0.98 and a manually-set warmup/min-LR schedule.
diff_from_baseline: Doesn't adopt the Lion/Muon/NAdam structural changes from the baselines; instead replaces global grad-clip with per-tensor renormalisation inside the step, raises β₂ to 0.98, and tunes the LR schedule (longer warmup, higher min_lr).

name: TrustAdamW: norm-gated layer-wise AdamW
tagline: AdamW with a LARS-style trust ratio (clipped to [0.5, 2.0]) on the projection matrices, gated by an EMA of grad-RMS; embeddings/biases use plain AdamW.
init_recovers: AdamW when trust ratio = 1 and gate = 1
diff_from_baseline: Doesn't take the orthogonalisation/sign route of Lion/Muon; instead per-projection adapts the AdamW step by a clamped layer-wise trust ratio plus a grad-RMS EMA gate, and scales token embeddings/lm_head with vanilla AdamW.

name: Muon + AdamW (faithful re-impl)
tagline: Reproduces the Muon baseline: Newton-Schulz on 2D non-embedding weights with Nesterov momentum, AdamW for embeddings, with longer warmup.
diff_from_baseline: Essentially the Muon baseline with two small tweaks: AdamW peak LR raised to 1e-3 (vs 6e-4) and warmup lengthened from 4 % to 10 % of training; algorithm itself is identical.
